summary: Korn Ferry completed its acquisition of Auxey Holdco Limited (AMS) on September 1, 2026, making AMS an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. Consideration comprised approximately €473 million and $326 million in cash (including debt repayment and transaction obligations) plus 3,118,628 Korn Ferry common shares issued to sellers. The acquisition follows a Purchase Agreement dated June 27, 2026, amended by deeds on July 29 and August 31, 2026, with effective closing at 12:01 a.m. London time on September 1. Watch for integration updates and potential dilution impact from the share issuance.
